dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline, indicating a high degree of falcation from the posterior dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded with a narrow pixel radius, forming a sharp transition to the concave trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin displays a shallow angular steepness of approximately 30 to 35 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 2.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular light-toned epidermal patches and subtle desquamation marks are visible across the mid-to-lower lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced hooked profile resulting from the extreme disparity between the shallow leading edge and the deeply recessed trailing edge.
